description: Terllama model registry — three download formats: fp (original weights), q4 (GGUF Q4_K_M), ternary (I2_S/ALS)
note: fp downloads original safetensors from the base HF repo; q4 downloads Q4_K_M GGUF from QuantFactory; ternary requires local FP32-to-ternary conversion unless pre-made ternary weights exist (none currently). Gated models need a HuggingFace access token (HF_TOKEN).

models.name: TinyLlama-1.1B
models.description: 1.1B parameter Llama-based model — fast CPU inference with ternary precision

fp.note: Original FP16 weights (safetensors). Not runnable by Terllama — source for conversion or external tools.

q4.note: GGUF Q4_K_M. Download-only: engine Q4 runtime support is in progress.

ternary.note: No pre-made ternary weights on HuggingFace — requires local conversion (downloads FP weights, converts on your CPU).
